title: Borromean Triads, the Ring Lemma, and Spectral Non-Dispersal: A Conditional Regularity Framework for 3D Navier-Stokes
desc: We present the Ring Lemma (Lemma 5.1): for a divergence-free velocity field with Fourier support in a single Littlewood-Paley shell S_{j*}, the vorticity direction field xi = omega/|omega| satisfies ||grad xi||_{L-inf} <= C * 2^{j*}, directly answering Constantin-Fefferman Question 2.2 in the band-limited regime.
